en: A black-and-white historic postcard showing a large town square with horse-drawn carriages and pedestrians. Prominent ornate buildings line the square, including a richly decorated city hall and adjacent residences, with a tall church tower rising in the background. At the top is printed text in Swedish, and handwritten upside‑down correspondence covers the upper portion of the card.
